style.styleTitle: Personalised Gonk Christmas Wooden Star Ornament by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Bring joy and whimsical charm to your festive décor with our Personalised Gonk Christmas Wooden Star Ornament, a delightful addition to any Christmas tree. Crafted from high-quality wood, this enchanting star-shaped decoration features an adorable gonk, a mythical Nordic-inspired character known for spreading festive cheer throughout the holiday season. Personalise this wooden star ornament with up to three lines of text, each allowing up to 20 characters, to create a truly unique keepsake for your home or as a thoughtful gift. Please note that line 1 is case sensitive and will appear exactly as entered; however, we recommend avoiding fixed uppercase on this line as it may make the script font harder to read. All other personalisation will appear in fixed uppercase lettering for a clear and stylish finish. Perfect for adding a personal touch to your Christmas decorations, this ornament makes a charming gift or festive keepsake to enjoy year after year. Dimensions(mm): Height: 185 Width: 185 Depth: 25
